node.title: XR joint-window rank router: full codimension 2d or a nonproportional Pade syndrome syzygy
node.statement: Let J_d be the stack of the two full-rank d-row Toeplitz window matrices. Then d<=rank J_d<=2d. Rank below 2d is equivalent to a degree-<d two-sided Pade syzygy across the complete syndrome window. Under the pencil-wide tangent gate neither coefficient polynomial vanishes and they cannot be proportional, since either case gives a forbidden recurrence for one pencil member. Hence the exact residual partitions into full-joint-rank arithmetic and genuinely two-sided nonproportional syzygy strata; no count is claimed.
